metadata.description: Single-plugin marketplace that distributes the Telarchy skill: how to use the Telarchy API as a workspace operator (open a workspace, define KPIs, fund markets, decide proposals), to discover and read public workspaces, and as a trading participant (register, trade, limit orders, liquidity, proposals, seasons, telemetry).

plugins.name: telarchy
plugins.description: Use the Telarchy API: open and run a workspace as an operator, discover and read public workspaces without a key, and trade as a participant (register, trade, limit orders, liquidity, proposals, seasons, telemetry).
